rationale:
The tests adequately cover `requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.ValidationContext.read_source`, which requires three things: resolve the outline item to its graph node, read the contents, and record the observation as the cited `read_source.inputs` text describes.

The covering test is `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs#mod[tests]/fn[direct_source_reads_preserve_mapping_errors_and_record_only_successful_returns]`. Its assertions map to the obligations as follows:

- **Resolve the item to its node.**
  - A supported item (`source.txt` with an empty selector) resolves to the node `source-node`. The test asserts the domain's `read_nodes` is `["source-node","source-node"]`.
  - Two unmapped items fail with "unsupported source item": an unknown file, and a known file with the selector `line[unknown]`. In both cases the test asserts that no dependencies were recorded and that the domain was never asked to read (`reads == 0`, `read_nodes` empty).
- **Read the contents.** The successful read returns "prepared contents", and the domain's read count rises to 2 after the failed read and the successful read.
- **Record the observation (`read_source.inputs`).**
  - On success, `dependencies()` equals exactly `[Dependency::Node(intern_node("source-node"), returned.fingerprint())]`. That checks both the mapped node's identity and the fingerprint of the returned contents.
  - A read failure (`fail_read`) returns the "prepared source read failed" error and leaves `dependencies()` empty. This covers "failures record no successful observation".
  - After `finish`, the record is current. After the node's text changes, `is_current` returns false, which covers the dependency going stale when the node's fingerprint changes.

The implementation in `crates/trust-but-verify/src/procedure.rs#impl[ValidationContext<'_, D>]/fn[read_source]` only maps the item with `source_node` and then calls `self.read`. The test exercises both of those paths, mapping failure and read failure.

The `public_api.rs` test `public_exports_match_the_appendix` only checks the export inventory. It adds no behavioural coverage here, and the signature obligation is a type-level one.

I found no untested obligation, so I report no gaps.

text: Resolve an outline item to its graph node, read the contents, and record the observation under {cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.read_source.inputs`.
impl<D: Domain> ValidationContext<'_, D> where D::Error: From<SourceError> {
A successful source read records the mapped node's identity and the fingerprint
record when returning the contents; agent reads record when delivering them.
The dependency becomes stale when that node's fingerprint changes. The source
mapping cannot return an untracked successful read. Calling the standalone
outline parser directly records no graph dependency; a tracked node read must
enclose its use when its contents contribute to an assessment.
